title: SA for MINIMUM conditional-entropy surah ordering
rules_tuple: (no-tashkeel, QAC-STEM roots, top-K=100, Dirichlet α=0.5, L1-norm, Fisher-Rao, rank-exp kernel)
verdict_note: 3/3 SA runs found orderings with H < H_mushaf = 50.1474 bits. SA lower bound on min H = 16.4548 bits. gap_fraction (mushaf ↔ SA-min vs null-mean) = 0.5069 (modestly-structured).
